definition: The total distance around the outside edge of a flat shape, measured in units of length such as cm or m.
The amount of flat surface inside a shape, measured in square units such as $\text{cm}^{2}$ or $\text{m}^{2}$.
The height of a shape measured at right angles to its base, not along a slanting side; in a triangle with an obtuse angle it can fall outside the shape, meeting the base extended.
